(1) we provide the first convergence result for the Ivanov type and the Morozov type IRGNMs, (2) we show how to obtain a convergence result for an adaptive discretization, and (3) we provide numerical results for an $$L^\infm $$L∞ valued source.

we have proven convergence of the IRGNMM in Banach space under a tangential conic constraint, and we have provided an adaptive discretization scheme for the IRGNMM that is based on a weighted dual residual estimator.

we have proven the convergence of the IRGNMs in Banach space setting under the weaker tangential cone condition and have shown how to control discretization errors in a way that allows to prove convergence of the discretized methods.

the Ivanov type method is the method of choice for nonlinear ill-posed problems in Banach space.
